source.notes: Rigid FR-4, 1 and 2 layers, 1 oz outer copper. Each rule names the row it comes from; rules marked as the author's choice are defaults, not limits. Re-read the page before ordering: JLCPCB changes it.

drill_files.source: The capabilities page (read 2026-11-11) gives hole tolerances ("Through-holes: +0.13 / -0.08 mm") but does not say whether drill-file sizes are finished or drilled sizes.

aspect_ratio_max.source: JLCPCB does not publish an aspect ratio: not checked.

clearance_fill_fill.source: Traces: Min. trace width/spacing, 1- and 2-layer: 0.10 / 0.10 mm (4 / 4 mil).

clearance_fill_hole.source: Drilling: Via hole to Track 0.2mm; Via Hole-to-Hole Spacing 0.2mm. Pad (PTH) holes need more (PTH to track 0.28 mm minimum; Pad Hole-to-Hole Spacing 0.45mm), which one hole rule cannot tell apart: check plated holes by hand.
